quickAdd.hint: Separate with commas or spaces. 1-20 is a range and 45x2 is two copies. Other rarities use their short name and number: SCR12 is card 12’s Secret Rare, and ranges work too (QCSR1-QCSR20).
quickAdd.empty: Cards run from RA05-EN001 to RA05-EN150.

help.tiers: Standard or Master: pick what you’re collecting above the cards. Standard is the 150 cards, each in its main rarity. Master adds the 542 other rarities. Cards you’ve marked are kept when you switch.

about.title: About the Rarity Collection 5 set
paragraphs: Rarity Collection 5 is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG special set released on 9 April 2026, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 150 cards, and with the 542 other rarities there are 692 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 150 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 692, adding the 542 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
